t: O My Allah! Whoever listens to our utterance which is just and which seeks the prosperity of religion and the worldly life and does not seek mischief, but rejects it after listening, then he certainly turns away from your support and desists from streghthening your religion. We make you a witness over him and you are the greatest of all witness, and we make all those who inhabit your earth and your skies witness over him. Thereafter, you alone can make us needless of his support and question him for his sin.
